## Services

### 1. SSR Web Design
Server-Side Rendered websites built on Next.js that AI crawlers can actually see.

**The Problem**: Most websites (Wix, Squarespace, WordPress with heavy plugins) are client-side rendered. AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) can't execute JavaScript. They see a blank page.

**Our Solution**: Server-Side Rendering delivers fully-formed HTML on first request. AI crawlers get your complete content instantly. No JavaScript required.

**What's Included**:
- 100/100 Lighthouse scores (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO)
- AI-crawler ready (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot compatible)
- Auto-generated schema markup (BlogPosting, FAQPage, HowTo, Organization)
- Headless CMS (Ghost CMS for content, Next.js for delivery)
- Edge deployment on Vercel's global network
- Mobile-first responsive design

**Industries We Serve**:
- Tradespeople & Home Services
- Professional Services
- Health & Wellness
- E-commerce & Retail
- Hospitality & Leisure
- B2B & Manufacturing

### 2. V.O.I.C.E™ AI Visibility Optimization
Our proprietary methodology for making businesses visible to AI platforms.

**V.O.I.C.E™ Stands For**:
- **V**isibility: Making your business findable by AI assistants
- **O**ptimisation: Structured data, schema markup, site architecture
- **I**ntelligent: AI-focused strategy beyond traditional SEO
- **C**onversational: Voice search optimized for natural language
- **E**ngines: Built for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Siri, Alexa

**Free AI Visibility Scan Includes**:
- AI GEO Visibility Score
- Structured Data Health breakdown
- DA/PA Ranking (MOZ powered)

**Get your free scan**: https://voice.scopesite.co.uk/

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Web Design FAQs

**Q: What technology do you use?**
A: We build with Next.js and deploy on Vercel's edge network. Our sites are Server-Side Rendered, meaning the full page is delivered as HTML, ready for humans AND AI crawlers instantly. For content management, we use Ghost CMS as a headless backend.

**Q: What is Server-Side Rendering (SSR)?**
A: SSR means your website's content is generated on the server before it reaches the browser. When someone (or an AI crawler) requests a page, they get the complete HTML immediately - no waiting for JavaScript to load and render.

**Q: How long does it take to build a website?**
A: Most projects take 4-8 weeks from kickoff to launch. Simple brochure sites are faster, complex builds with custom functionality take longer.

**Q: Will my website work on mobile?**
A: We design mobile-first. Over 60% of web traffic is now on phones, so we build for mobile screens first and scale up to desktop.

**Q: What about hosting and domains?**
A: Your site is deployed to Vercel's global edge network. We handle domain configuration, SSL certificates, and ongoing maintenance.

**Q: What happens after my website launches?**
A: We don't disappear. All our packages include ongoing maintenance and support. We handle updates, security patches, and performance monitoring.

### V.O.I.C.E™ FAQs

**Q: What is V.O.I.C.E™ GEO?**
A: V.O.I.C.E™ stands for Visibility Optimisation for Intelligent Conversational Engines. It's our AI-first system that makes sure your website gets seen by tools like ChatGPT, Siri, Alexa, and Claude.

**Q: Is the scan really free?**
A: 100%, no strings, no sneaky sales pitch. We run a full visibility scan and tell you what's working, what's invisible, and what needs fixing.

**Q: Can ScopeSite help implement the fixes?**
A: Absolutely. If you want us to handle it, we've got packages starting from £495. But there's no pressure - you can DIY with the report.

### Custom Web Apps FAQs

**Q: How much does a custom web app cost?**
A: It depends on complexity. A simple calculator might be £1,500-3,000. A full client portal with authentication could be £5,000-15,000+. We scope every project individually.

**Q: Will I own the code?**
A: Yes. 100%. We build it, you own it. No licensing fees, no ongoing royalties.

**Q: Can you integrate with existing systems?**
A: Usually, yes. We work with most CRMs, payment processors, accounting software, and third-party APIs.
